title: Bail Denial Expansion
officialSummary: Proposing an amendment to the Constitution of Alabama of 2022, relating to bail, to allow courts to deny bail for a defendant charged with solicitation, attempt, or conspiracy to commit murder, or the offense of shooting or discharging a firearm, explosive, or other weapon into an occupied dwelling, building, vehicle, aircraft, railroad car, or watercraft.
plainEnglish: This amendment would allow judges to deny bail for additional serious offenses. It adds solicitation, attempt, or conspiracy to commit murder, and shooting or discharging a firearm, explosive, or other weapon into an occupied dwelling, building, vehicle, aircraft, train car, or watercraft.

title: District Attorney Salary Protection
officialSummary: Proposing an amendment to the Constitution of Alabama of 2022, relating to the compensation of district attorneys, to provide that the salary of a district attorney may not be diminished during the term for which the district attorney was elected or appointed.
plainEnglish: This amendment would prevent a district attorney's salary from being reduced during the term they were elected or appointed to serve.
